description: Fjernvarme-konsesjon avgrensning Stjørdal kommune is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stjørdal kommune. Avgrensning av fjernvarme-konsesjon i Stjørdal. Coverage: Stjørdal kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Stjørdal kommune. Its keywords include Energi, Local, Stjørdal kommune, Trøndelag, Konsesjonsområde, Konsesjon. The listing shows 1 download or service links in TXT. The listing shows 2019-03-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.kartverket.no/geodataarbeid/norge-digitalt/partsinformasjon/avtaler-og-vilkar/norge-digitalt-lisens). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
